english.title: Attempt to gain entry to / remain on a part of the Croydon Tramlink system where access prohibited by notice / reserved
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) not being an authorised person attempted to enter or remain on a part of the Croydon Tramlink System, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OR AREA..), where there was a notice

(A)_[prohibiting access]_
(B)_[indicating that it was reserved or provided for a specified category of person only, being a category to which you did not belong]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 14(1), 30 and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
